title: Unicorn holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <path d='M28 40 Q24 50 26 60' stroke='#c8b6ff' stroke-width='1.4' fill='none'/>
  <!-- balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='27' rx='11' ry='13' fill='#ff5470'/>

  <ellipse cx='62' cy='72' rx='20' ry='9' fill='#e6d6ff'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='45' y='76' width='6' height='14' rx='3' fill='#fdf7ff'/>
  <rect x='55' y='78' width='6' height='12' rx='3' fill='#e6d6ff'/>
  <rect x='68' y='78' width='6' height='12' rx='3' fill='#fdf7ff'/>
  <rect x='77' y='76' width='6' height='14' rx='3' fill='#e6d6ff'/>

  <path d='M83 60 Q93 62 91 74 Q89 66 84 68 Q92 70 89 80 Q85 70 82 70 z' fill='#8f6bff'/>

  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='55' cy='31' r='2.6' fill='#5b3fa8'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='30' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- ear -->
  <path d='M62 25 l4 -7 l2 8 z' fill='#fdf7ff'/>
  <path d='M63 24 l2.5 -4 l1 4 z' fill='#ffc2d6'/>
  <!-- horn -->
  <path d='M52 24 l3 -12 l4 12 z' fill='#ffd76a'/>
  <path d='M53.5 20 l3.5 0 M54 16 l3 0' stroke='#e0a92e' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- mane -->
  <path d='M46 28 Q40 34 42 42 Q38 38 40 32 Q36 36 38 44' fill='none' stroke='#8f6bff' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M44 40 Q40 46 42 54' fill='none' stroke='#8f6bff' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
